verdict.rationale: Rive's cloud-based Editor saves and stores user files, as its revision history shows, so data region or residency is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to choose a storage region or residency. Revision history and autosave are adjacent storage features and do not give region choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
